name: Relief and Rehabilitation Assistance to Sri Lankan Refugees in the Refugee Camps
benefit:
> **(a) Food for Temporary Stay in Different Camps** 1. In Quarantine Camp refugees are provided cooked food @ ₹ 45/- per day per adult, and @ ₹ 30/- per day per child. 1. Refugees in Special Camps are provided cooked food @ ₹ 70/- per day per adult. 1. Clothing material is also provided.

_eligibility_text:
